title: The Pathan Warning and Tara Singh’s Refusal to Hide

blocks.text: A friendly Pathan came running on horseback to warn the Singhs that escape was still possible, but Tara Singh answers that they have already accepted the path of witness and will not save themselves by concealment.

The domestic scene that follows, with companions filling a big tub with water, only sharpens his rebuke: he says the body gets sanctified with the touch of a weapon when it is offered in righteous battle, not by comfort or delay.
He therefore makes the issue plain for everyone present: anyone willing to escape should escape now, and whoever remains should come out armed into the field beside him.
